test_cases.input: why can't we just compare the generated sql query with the correct one character by character?
test_cases.expected_output: Comparing the generated SQL query with the correct query character by character is not a good strategy, because a single result can be produced by multiple different queries. The query your data analyst wrote and the query the LLM generated to solve the same problem may be different textually, yet both are correct. So instead of matching the query strings, you run both queries on the database, get a result set—a table—from each, and compare the two tables. If both tables are the same, the generated query is considered correct.

But when you build your own golden dataset for your actual task and run both models on it, the accuracy difference turns out to be small, while the smaller model is much cheaper and faster.
